[P2] Bind retry observations to the suspended execution and its history

These checks accept any recorded request, including a peer belonging to another execution. The retry operation also need not exist in `replay.after` or the collected history: removing it from both leaves the retry checks satisfied. Consequently, unrelated or uncheckpointed work can satisfy `lmi-lifecycle-5`. Require every retry attempt to belong to the selected execution and require the retried operation to appear with a successful outcome in its collected final history. Add negative tests for both substitutions.
